messages:
Priya (People Ops): Heads up: new manager starts Mon 04/11. I'm building a compact Day 0/Day 1 checklist plus a brief 30/60/90 scaffold that mgmt can use. Want quick feedback on what to lock in now.

Lina (Hiring Manager): Great. Please include a list of immediate contacts (payroll, IT, security) and who to loop for urgent access.

Priya (People Ops): Draft Day 0 email (to send 48h pre-start):
```
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — Day 1 logistics
Hi {{name}},
Quick items for Monday:
- Bring ID for payroll verification
- Confirm laptop delivery (IT)
- Join zoom at 09:00 for People Ops welcome
Links: benefits, SSO setup, calendar invites
See you Monday!
```

Maya (HR): Add benefits enrollment deadline and EOR paperwork note. Also attach the manager-specific handbook (manager privileges and performance review cadence).

Carlos (IT): I'll flag potential SSO delays. New manager will need: admin console access, repo perms, infra read-only, datadog dashboards. Pre-provisioning ETA: 24h if ticket filed today.

Sam (Eng Manager): For Day 1 agenda, please keep it light. My suggestion: 09:00 intro + policies, 10:00 IT & access, 11:00 team intros, 13:00 meet direct reports, 15:00 30/60/90 sketch session.

Priya (People Ops): Good. For the 30/60/90, I'm proposing a single sheet with three rows (30/60/90) and columns: Objectives, Success metrics, Blockers, Owner. Short, measurable.

Lina (Hiring Manager): Who signs the 30/60/90? I prefer manager's manager signs off on objectives, then weekly check-ins with the skip-level for first 6 weeks.

Maya (HR): Affirmed. Also add a checkbox for manager training enrollment (people management course) in week 2.

Priya (People Ops): Escape hatch plan: If blocked on access >2 hours, ping @Carlos and @Onboarding Bot will open an IT triage call. Also call Mgr Ops pager for payroll issues.

Carlos (IT): I'll create the triage shortcut and add instructions to the Day 0 email: "If you can't access X, click here to start a triage call" (automated link).

Sam (Eng Manager): Can we include an onboarding lightning checklist for 1st 7 days for managers specifically? Things like: meet each direct report, review last 3 sprint retros, check SLA dashboards, identify quick win.

Priya (People Ops): I'll add a 7-day manager checklist annex. Here's a short example entry:
- Day 1: Complete access, meet team, set 1:1s
- Day 2-3: Review roadmaps & OKRs, attend standups
- Day 4: Shadow incident triage
- End of week: Draft 30/60/90 and share with skip-level

Lina (Hiring Manager): Nice. Can People Ops host a 30-min "how we do 30/60/90" office hour the week they start? I can co-host.

Priya (People Ops): Yes, scheduling that for Thu of week 1.

Onboarding Bot: Reminder created: send Day 0 email 48h before start, schedule Day 1 agenda 24h before, auto-cc IT ticket.

Maya (HR): Also confirm payroll & benefits are set up before day 5. We had one manager last quarter who missed open enrollment because of delay.

Carlos (IT): Noted. I'll aim for all access by Day 0 EOD; will post ticket link when done.

Priya (People Ops): Action owners: Carlos = access provisioning, Maya = payroll & handbook, Sam = team intros & 30/60/90 reviewer, Lina = hire context & skip-level signoff, Priya = calendar templates + office hour. I'll post the final packet here tomorrow.

Sam (Eng Manager): I'll drop a sample 30/60/90 I used (very tactical) into the channel shortly.

Priya (People Ops): Thanks all. Closing thread for now — will update once packet is live: https://redwoodinc.slack.com/archives/people-ops/p-new-manager-kit :party_parrot:
